title: How to Build a Simple Skincare Routine: A Beginner's Guide
ex: How to build a simple skincare routine with just three steps, choose a face cream for daily use, and add a brightening cream later without confusing your skin.
rt: How to Build a Simple Skincare Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: How to build a simple skincare routine: three morning and night basics, choosing a daily face cream online, and adding a brightening cream slowly.
keyword: how to build a simple skincare routine
quick: Start with three steps: a gentle cleanser, a moisturiser that suits your skin type and SPF 30 sunscreen every morning, then cleanser and moisturiser at night. After 3–4 weeks, add one product at a time, such as a brightening night cream, and patch test each one.
facts: Cleanser, moisturiser and sunscreen are the three basics.
Add one new product every two weeks.
Indian sun is strong all year, so sunscreen matters daily.
A more even look usually takes 8–12 weeks.
